# bio pack

Components for biological and chemical structure data — molecular viewers, plate layouts.

## data-display

- [`<atk-molstar>`](atk-molstar.md) — Interactive 3D macromolecular structure viewer.
  - Use when: Displaying 3D protein, ligand, or nucleic acid structures in biological and chemical research reports.
- [`<atk-well-plate>`](atk-well-plate.md) — High-throughput 96-well or 384-well microplate heatmap visualizer.
  - Use when: Use when displaying assay screening data, compound concentration layouts, or biological quality control across standard 96-well or 384-well microplates.
